title: The Smurfs and the big party.
lines: Deep in a big forest, far away from people, there's a little village.
Big red and white mushrooms, with little doors and windows.
They're as tall as three apples stacked up.
They wear white trousers and a white hat.
And they talk a bit funny.
They say smurf instead of lots of other words.
The boss of the village is Papa Smurf.
He has a white beard and wears a red hat and red trousers.
There are lots and lots of Smurfs.
Jokey Smurf is always cheerful and plays jokes.
Harmony Smurf plays his trumpet, but very out of tune.
And Smurfette, with her long yellow hair.
One morning Papa Smurf calls all the Smurfs together.
Smurfs, he says, in three days it's the big Smurf party.
We have to get everything ready.
Handy Smurf builds a big stage.
Baker Smurf bakes a giant smurfberry cake.
Smurfberries are small, red and very sweet.
Oh dear, that doesn't sound very good yet.
And Smurfette makes flower crowns for everyone.
But there's someone who isn't happy about the party.
Far away, in a dark castle, lives Gargamel.
He's mean and a bit silly.
He has a cat called Azrael.
Gargamel wants to catch the Smurfs.
Because he wants to make a magic potion.
Then all the Smurfs will be together.
Then I'll catch them all at once!
They hide behind a bush, close to the village.
But Smurfette is picking flowers in the forest.
She sees a big nose behind the bush.
She runs back to the village as fast as she can.
He wants to catch us during the party!
Can you make a big Smurf out of wood and cloth?
The next evening is the party.
Gargamel watches from behind his bush.
Then he sees something very strange.
And it says in a deep voice: Who dares to bother my little Smurfs?
Of course it's all the Smurfs together, inside it.
And Harmony Smurf is blowing through a long pipe, in a very deep voice.
He runs into the forest as fast as he can.
They trip and roll into a muddy puddle.
All the Smurfs climb out of the giant Smurf.
And now the party can begin.
And Harmony Smurf plays his trumpet.
